info.title: Simple Hearing Aid Care
info.subtitle: A few minutes a day keeps devices clear and lasting

rows.title: Wipe It Daily
rows.desc: A soft dry cloth clears wax and moisture.

rows.title: Keep It Dry
rows.desc: Store in a drying case or dehumidifier overnight.

rows.title: Change Wax Guards
rows.desc: Swap the tiny filter when sound turns faint.

rows.title: Open Battery Doors
rows.desc: Let air in to prevent moisture buildup.

rows.title: See Us for Repairs
rows.desc: Professional service beats risky DIY fixes.
